name: apiKey
label: API key
help: Your Civo API key, from the Civo dashboard under Account → Settings → Security → API keys. Sent as a bearer token on every request.

name: region
label: Region
help: The Civo region code this connection monitors, e.g. `LON1`, `NYC1`, `FRA1` or `PHX1` (or a CivoStack / private region code). Each plugin instance monitors a single region — add the plugin again for other regions. Run the Regions data stream after connecting to see the codes available to your account.
